title: Mohmand campaign of 1897–1898
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Mohmand campaign of 1897–1898", at revision 1370628380, opens: "The First Mohmand campaign was a British military campaign against the Pashtun Mohmand tribe from 1897 to 1898." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5453350, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "19th century British military campaign in India (1897-1898)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
